name: changelog
title: Changelog
description: Release notes: version and date on the left, tagged New, Improved, Fixed or Removed changes on the right.
htmlExample: <bef-changelog class="w-full max-w-2xl" :releases='[{"version":"1.4.0","date":"Oct 7, 2026","title":"Time components","changes":[{"type":"new","text":"Time picker, analog clock, world clock, stopwatch and timer."},{"type":"improved","text":"Heatmap cells now show a tooltip with the exact count."}]},{"version":"1.3.2","date":"Sep 21, 2026","changes":[{"type":"fixed","text":"Combobox kept the old highlight after the list was filtered."},{"type":"removed","text":"The deprecated \"ghost-outline\" button variant."}]}]'></bef-changelog>
